result: At pinned modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, successful modern discover_startup stores the selected protocol version plus client Implementation and ClientCapabilities in Peer::client_request_metadata before serve_inner starts. A concrete ordinary no-options path, Peer<RoleClient>::call_tool_once, constructs ClientRequest::CallToolRequest and calls Peer::send_request. send_request_with_option_and_subscription then writes protocol_version, client_info, and client_capabilities into request.get_meta_mut() before queueing PeerSinkMessage::Request. serve_inner receives that same mutated request, wraps it with JsonRpcMessage::request, and passes it to transport.send. Thus this concrete post-discover request has the two 2026-07-28 required client-context keys plus clientInfo attached before transport.send. The direct path is narrower than previously stated: serve_directly_with_ct calls RoleClient::configure_direct_peer, which seeds the same defaults when supplied peer_info is protocol 2026-07-28 or newer; absent/older peer_info does not.
source_scope: Own clean LATEST, required sanitized controls, own role config, and pinned public rust-sdk source only. Default-branch code-search snippets were navigation only. No O, other-worker, downstream, legacy, shared-ledger, or other-role semantic input was used.
scope_guard: Positive evidence is limited to source-level control flow at the pinned commit and the concrete no-options call_tool_once path after a successful modern discover. No claim is made about deployed servers, authentication, ChatGPT connector exposure, actual bytes observed on a network, or callers supplying PeerRequestOptions.meta. Explicit options.meta is applied after the seeded defaults, so its override semantics remain outside this positive scope.
remaining_unresolved_child: Trace RequestMetaObject serde/wire field mapping for the same concrete no-options post-discover request and verify the required key strings are serialized under JSON-RPC request _meta, then separately characterize PeerRequestOptions.meta override semantics.
